root_idea.summary: The root centers on a high, loud sound or cry.
root_idea.development: The basic sound notion yields the noun صَيْحَة for one loud cry. Lexical tradition also extends it metaphorically to the upward growth of a tree or plant. Expressions for cracking and splitting are recorded in this lexical discussion, while the root analysis identifies that branch as historically related to the waw-based root صوح.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quran-attested nominal صيحة is a distinct lexical item and is displayed under its normalized citation form.

senses.definition: A loud cry, shout, or blast; one instance of loud calling.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic noun is singular in form. Its contexts are variously rendered as a shout, cry, or blast, with the surrounding passage determining whether the sound is ordinary, catastrophic, or eschatological.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To raise one's voice, cry aloud, shout, exclaim, or vociferate.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It may be done vehemently or with utmost force. The expression is used of a person and also, more broadly, of other things; it is especially associated with animals and often crow-like birds, and occasionally with a spear by comparison.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To call out to, hail, or summon someone or something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Common constructions include صَاحَ بِهِ and صَاحَ لِفُلَانٍ, as well as the imperative صِحْ لِي بِفُلَانٍ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be frightened or terrified.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the passive construction صِيحَ بِهِمْ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To perish.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This meaning is associated with the passive construction صِيحَ فِيهِمْ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Before daybreak, or before everything else.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic expression used with meeting or coming before the time of general activity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For neither little nor much; for nothing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic expression describing anger or another reaction without any appreciable cause.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become tall or extend upward; of a tree or palm, to grow tall, and of a raceme, to emerge fully and lengthen.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression is also used of a palm spathe putting forth its spadix or raceme to its full length.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To break, split, cleave, or slit a thing extensively.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a causative Form II use applied to an object that is broken or divided much.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become much broken, cloven, split, or slit.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The use is intransitive and describes the resulting condition of a thing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a sword scabbard or sheath, to become much split or slit.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension describing extensive splitting, compared with a structure coming apart.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a garment or piece of cloth, to become slit or rent; of a staff, to become cracked or split.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a Form VII intransitive use describing an object becoming cleft or damaged.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of dawn or lightning, to show its light or break forth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a figurative extension associated with cleaving or opening apart.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Sudden evil or mischief arriving unexpectedly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In the expression صَيْحَةُ الْحُبْلَى, the pregnant woman's cry is used figuratively for trouble that comes suddenly.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Punishment, chastisement, or castigation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a conventional extended meaning of the noun rather than its basic sense of a loud cry.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A hostile or predatory incursion that surprises a tribe.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The meaning describes a sudden raid or attack.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The calling, crying, or calling out of people to one another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The corresponding Form III usage describes reciprocal vocal calling among people or a group.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A kind of date from Medina, described as black and hard to chew.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The name is explained as a relational form associated with a ram called صَيْحَان or الصَّيَّاح.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A clamorous person; anything noisy or making much sound.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The form may describe either a person characterized by clamour or a noisy thing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A name for the constellation Bootes.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a conventional astronomical name.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A perfume or fragrant substance; also a wash for the head.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The preparation may consist of خَلُوق and similar materials.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The crying or clamour at a place where women are wailing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun denotes the sound or commotion associated with such a place of mourning.

cautions: The Quranic public form is the noun صَيْحَة; “blast” is a context-sensitive rendering of its loud-cry sense, not a separate QAC form.
The splitting and cracking meanings belong to separate Classical derived-form branches and are not Quranic meanings of صَيْحَة.
